Synthetic metallic hair in a bright lemon yellow shade, styled into two large, rounded mechanical buns. Glowing turquoise circular eyes with a digital, robotic expression. Apparent age of a young adult, though constructed from polished white and gold metal. Slender robotic build with a gold-plated chassis and a small white torso. Wearing a gold and white robotic dress with a red bow on the chest and a gold trim. Features a mechanical antenna on the head and a retractable weapon system in the arms.
BODY COLOR: polished white
